label: MONEY STORY
hook: Anjali earned ₹32,000 but never knew where it went…

slides.text: So for 7 days, she wrote down every rupee she spent.
New rule: order on weekends only, about ₹1,600 a month.
That freed ₹2,600 a month for her emergency fund.
Lesson: track before you cut. Try a 7-day spending note today.
